```yaml
name: Test Count

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  count-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest
    
    - name: Count tests
      id: count
      run: |
        import json
        import subprocess
        import re
        
        # Run pytest to get test count
        result = subprocess.run(['pytest', '--collect-only', '--quiet'], 
                              capture_output=True, text=True)
        
        # Extract test count from output
        output = result.stdout + result.stderr
        test_count = 0
        
        # Look for lines containing "test" and count them
        lines = output.split('\n')
        for line in lines:
            if 'test_' in line and not line.startswith('collected'):
                test_count += 1
        
        # If we couldn't find it via parsing, try alternative method
        if test_count == 0:
            # Try to parse collected count
            collected_match = re.search(r'collected (\d+) items?', output)
            if collected_match:
                test_count = int(collected_match.group(1))
        
        # Write to file for badge generation
        with open('test-stats.json', 'w') as f:
            json.dump({'tests': test_count}, f)
        
        print(f"::set-output name=test_count::{test_count}")
    
    - name: Generate badge
      uses: schneegans/dynamic-badges-action@v1.7.0
      with:
        auth-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        badge-path: "docs/badges/test-count.svg"
        label: "Tests"
        message: "${{ steps.count.outputs.test_count }}"
        color: "brightgreen"
        style: "flat"
    
    - name: Update README with badge
      run: |
        # Add badge to README after existing badges
        sed -i '/<!-- badges -->/a [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-${{ steps.count.outputs.test_count }}-brightgreen)](https://github.com/SkBlaz/py3plex/actions/workflows/test-count.yml)' README.md
    
    - name: Commit changes
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
        git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
        git add test-stats.json docs/badges/test-count.svg README.md
        git commit -m "Update test count badge" || echo "No changes to commit"
        git push origin main || echo "No changes to push"
```
